what_this_is: How the reach of each of a person's AIs reads on Account & security and inside a pursuit (src/ai-reach.mjs), and the choices offered there after an AI has connected. The consent page's own choices (src/reach-choices.json) come first in the same order; `more_choices` adds the shapes a reach can also have once an AI was added to a pursuit or a key was made with less. `{spaces}` is the names of the pursuits, joined by `joiner` with `last_joiner` before the last.

more_choices.label: My private Trillion and pursuits I pick
Every pursuit shared with others, nothing else

reads.every_space: Every pursuit shared with others, nothing else
reads.unknown: Shown after it is next used
reads.differs: Set differently on each of its sign-ins

fields.unknown_note: Use this app with Trillion once, then you can change what it reaches here.

said.saved: {name} now reaches: {reach}. This takes effect on its next request.
said.added: {name} can now read and add to this pursuit.

in_space.description: {name}, one of its member's AIs, reads and adds to this pursuit.
